$comment: Single source of (os, arch) truth for all release workflows. Read at job start via jq and consumed as a matrix include via fromJSON. Adding a new target = adding one entry here; both release-desktop.yml and release-server.yml pick it up automatically (server matrix is linux-only by definition). `artifact_exts` lists every artifact extension electron-builder produces for that target — the build step collects each, the manifest job enumerates them.
